We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner, R&D to partner with managers across the Engineering and Product functions to strengthen manager capability, build high-performing teams, and drive business and talent outcomes.

This hands-on role focuses on manager coaching, performance management, compensation planning, organizational health, and people program execution. As a trusted advisor, you will help managers navigate complex people decisions, improve team performance, and build the capabilities required to achieve business objectives.  You will diagnose organizational challenges, identify opportunities and translate them into practical, high-impact people solutions. You will also help shape the future of HR business partnering by leveraging AI and agentic workflows to improve decision quality, expand HRBP leverage, enhance manager support, and deliver scalable people solutions.

This role is designed for a highly accountable HRBP who thrives in a high-velocity environment, takes ownership of outcomes, has strong bias for action, proactively solves problems, and continuously improves how work gets done.  The ideal candidate combines the judgment of a trusted advisor, the execution rigor of an operator, and the mindset of a builder.

Scope of Impact

Business Partnership

  • Build trusted partnerships with managers and leaders across supported R&D organizations, serving as a credible advisor on talent, organization, and people-related decisions.
  • Translate business objectives into practical solutions that enable organizational effectiveness.
  • Balance business priorities, employee experience, and long-term organizational implications when advising managers
  • Proactively identify organizational risks, capability gaps, talent concerns, and workforce trends, and drive recommendations that improve business outcomes.

Manager & Leadership Capability

  • Advise first-line and mid-level managers on people leadership, performance management, employee development, engagement, organizational health, and team effectiveness.
  • Identify capability gaps and implement targeted interventions that strengthen manager effectiveness and team performance.
  • Coach managers through challenging employee situations, difficult conversations, performance concerns, organizational change, and development planning.
  • Provide guidance on HR policies, processes, and people practices while reinforcing broader organizational considerations.
  • Deliver manager enablement and leadership development initiatives that improve effectiveness and consistency at scale.

Performance, Talent Management and Compensation 

  • Own execution of annual people programs, including performance reviews, calibration discussions, talent reviews, and compensation planning, ensuring high-quality outcomes and strong manager engagement
  • Coach managers through complex performance management decisions and strengthen performance expectations, accountability, and employee development practices.
  • Identify talent, retention, succession, and capability risks and develop mitigation plans with managers 
  • Partner on compensation decisions aligned with company philosophy and leverage workforce insights to improve decision quality.

HR Program Design, Execution & AI-Enabled Transformation

  • Design, implement, scale, and improve people programs that enhance manager effectiveness and organizational outcomes.
  • Simplify, automate, and redesign people processes with a focus on outcomes rather than digitizing legacy workflows.
  • Champion AI, automation, and agentic workflows across HRBP work to improve decision quality, increase capacity, and deliver scalable people solutions and  impact beyond traditional human capacity.
  • Deliver integrated HR solutions in partnership with the broader People team and identify innovative approaches that improve productivity, adoption, and effectiveness.

Organizational Health, Engagement & Development

  • Advise leaders on organizational health, culture, and team effectiveness while strengthening the development, retention, and engagement of key talent.
  • Use workforce sentiment, organizational insights, and people analytics to identify risks, diagnose challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.

Employee Relations

  • Provide guidance and independently manage moderate to complex employee relations matters using sound judgment and risk assessment.
  • Resolve employee concerns in partnership with managers and collaborate with Legal on sensitive, high-risk, or specialized matters.

How You Create Impact

  • Translate complex business priorities into focused, executable people solutions.
  • Influence decisions through expertise, credibility, and practical problem-solving.
  • Demonstrate urgency, ownership, and follow-through while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Leverage data, organizational insight, and systems thinking to diagnose challenges and develop scalable solutions.
  • Strengthen manager effectiveness through coaching, development, and enablement.
  • Drive execution of talent, performance, compensation, and people programs that improve organizational outcomes.
  • Navigate employee relations and performance matters with sound judgment and appropriate risk assessment.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to increase impact, productivity, and scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • Be known for speed, ownership, sound judgment, and turning ambiguous people challenges into actionable solutions.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with managers who proactively seek your guidance on critical talent and organizational decisions.
  • Elevate manager capability, accountability, and team effectiveness across supported organizations.
  • Deliver strong execution of performance, talent, compensation, and people programs that improve business outcomes.
  • Anticipate organizational risks and continuously improve how people work is delivered through AI, automation, and scalable solutions.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3+ years as a People Partner or HR Business Partner, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; or 6+ years of experience with a Master's degree.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on, technically deep Cloud Architect to serve as the critical technical bridge between our Engineering, Product Management, and Field teams. In this role, you will act as the primary subject matter expert on the cloud services we support, ensuring our product vision translates into technically sound, commercially viable solutions.

You thrive at the intersection of technical execution and product strategy. You’ll guide Product Managers during the product development process to ensure first releases of our features meet rigorous enterprise standards, while simultaneously partnering with field teams to ensure post-sale implementations land successfully in complex customer cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Product Strategy & Design: Serve as the technical SME to help PMs translate complex cloud requirements into actionable product requirements and PRDs.

• Architecture Validation: Work closely with PM and Engineering to design and validate architectures and workflows that meet enterprise-grade performance and security standards.

• Implementation Excellence: Lead the "last mile" of product success by ensuring field teams have the right documentation, technical enablement, and architectural guides to make post-sale implementations successful.

Qualifications

• Technical Depth: Strong expertise in major cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, APIs, and identity services.

• Execution: Proven ability to go "hands-on"—you can perform deep-dive demos, validate complex integrations, and troubleshoot implementation hurdles in real-time.

• Communication: Excellent skills in translating technical nuances into business value for both executive stakeholders and technical practitioners.

• Collaboration: Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams in a fast-paced environment

Preferred:

• Specialization: Prior experience in cloud security, data resilience, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.  Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.
About the role

This role runs the internal posture engine — the risk register, critical control monitoring, evidence, audit operations and GRC tooling. It keeps risk state current so the Lead and the Risk Committee decide from accurate data in the Risk Dashboard and reporting. Drata is the register of record. Named owners close gaps; this role keeps the register, evidence and audit operations current.

Responsibilities

Planning

• Operate the risk register from the Security Programme threat model: populate, track treatment, record acceptance decisions, follow up owners, and run the exceptions register.

• Keep the ISMS and security policy library current as part of audit readiness. Draft security standards when commissioned by the Lead.

• Run Drata as the control and evidence system — Statement of Applicability, framework crosswalk and automation.

Execution

• Run critical control monitoring: health check-ins, drift flags and Drata automation. Route drift to the SOC. Maintain the evidence file for Lead assessments and independent internal audit.

• Feed threat-assessment findings into the register and confidence ratings. Track which required assessments are current.

• Lead audit coordination and preparation: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 logistics, ISMS readiness, team prep, management-review pack, and customer due-diligence questionnaires.

• Coordinate the control register for external testing (red team, tabletop, pentest). Run security awareness and weekly alerts.

Tracking and evaluating performance

• Track residual risk, exceptions and gap-closure against appetite. Exceptions expire and are reported; the underlying requirement stays in force.

• Report register state and evidence health so the Lead and Risk Committee work from one view.

Achieving overall defined performance

• Be accountable for a current, defensible posture engine — register, evidence and audit operations.

• Ensure Drata collects evidence continuously, with automated evidence where coverage exists.

Qualifications

• Hands-on experience running a risk register, control library and audit cycle (ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2).

• Comfortable with GRC platforms (Drata or equivalent) and turning monitoring into evidence.

• Proven ability to coordinate audits and customer questionnaires with named control owners.

• Precise written work; register and Statement of Applicability quality matters.

• Strong stakeholder management with control owners and auditors.

• CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, or equivalent professional certification.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

We are committed to fostering a team-focused approach in our work of building great user-focused systems, while also placing a serious emphasis on quality of life, openness, empathy, and a supportive work environment.

The position

We're looking for a full-time Director of Business Development to lead our efforts to expand our client base. For a long time silverorange successfully relied on word of mouth and existing partnerships to sustain our growth - we have now reached a point where we feel we need a dedicated business development specialist in order to meet our business goals. We’re looking for a strategic and proactive person who will leverage their expertise to shape our business development strategy and implement the processes to support sustained growth. 

This position is available immediately and we will work with you to get you started as soon as possible.

Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and implement a strategic business development plan. 

• Build out our sales pipeline; implement and maintain a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system or alternative for leads.

• Seek out, establish, and cultivate new client relationships.

• Act as the face of the company for events, client visits, business mixers etc. 

• Seek and respond to appropriate requests for proposals; create proposals for potential new clients.

• Recommend a business-to-business marketing strategy while keeping an eye on industry trends, advise leadership of potential new markets and research to support our services.

• Maintain and/or coordinate open communication with existing and former clients to foster future work.

• Regularly report to the operations team on business development activities.

Requirements

• Be eligible & available to work from Canada. 

• Be willing and able to travel nationally and internationally to meet with prospective clients.

• 5+ years of experience leading business-to-business sales for an organization in the digital services industry.

• Experience developing, maintaining, and implementing a business development plan and actively managing a sales pipeline.

• Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills. Experience working in a remote or asynchronous environment is an asset.

• Strong sense of ownership over and self-direction in the work.

• Strong client management skills.

Growth & ownership

Our team is co-operative and will help you learn and expand your skills via mentoring, team-wide support, and learning opportunities. All members of the team are encouraged and given space to grow as individual contributors, and have ongoing opportunities in project and team leadership.

We’re excited to hear your fresh ideas and approach. We have decades of collective experience, and we all continue to become better at what we do by both teaching and learning from each other. Add your voice to our mix!

Opportunity for employee ownership is a fundamental part of silverorange (non-founders currently own more than a third of the company) and we’re currently working on new ways to transfer even more ownership to employees.

Inclusion & diversity

People with different backgrounds and experiences make us stronger, and we’re always looking for ways to improve. Our team is getting more diverse across many dimensions of diversity, but we’re still missing perspectives that could make our work better. We highly encourage people from traditionally underrepresented groups in our industry to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

Remote working is just as good as local

Our team has been remote-friendly for over 20 years, and remote-first for the last 10. We continue to improve our approach to having a dispersed team. This is a full-time remote position regardless of location, though you are welcome to work from our lovely offices in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Canada if you wish.

The majority of our team is full-time remote and 95% of our clients are remote. You’ll need to be comfortable working with a remote team regardless of your location.

Typically all employees spend at least one week each year working from our Charlottetown office, so plan on visiting PEI semi-regularly.

Though you may be working remotely, you’ll be an active member of a great and small but growing team, both here at silverorange and with our clients. Regular voice or video communication will help keep you in touch with the smart people with whom you’ll be working.

Benefits & compensation

• Flexible work days, approached collaboratively with you to allow for the realities of appointments, family minding, and your everyday life.

• 3 weeks of paid vacation, on top of 10 paid days of civic holidays, and 3 weeks of paid company-wide shut down.

• Generous health and dental coverage, with 100% of premium covered by silverorange.

• New computer hardware every 4 years, and other tools as needed.

• Yearly company-wide bonuses based on overall company success, plus ownership opportunities and dividends for long-term employees.

• Salaries based on skills and experience ranging from CAD $80,500 - $98,500, with both annual company wide salary band adjustments as well as opportunities and expectation of ongoing career and compensation growth.

• Additional remote worker salary add-on of CAD $3,000 per year and a wellness salary add-on of $500 per year.

How to apply

We will be accepting applications until noon Atlantic time on Friday, November 27th. We will begin reviewing applications and following up with candidates after this date.

Click 'Apply Now' and include a copy of your resume, and an explanation of why you’d be great for the job. 

We want people to feel they can be their genuine selves at work, so we’d love to hear about who you are. If there is anything else you would like to share with us — i.e. a Medium account, online writing or select blog posts, etc. — please feel free to include those as well.

If you require accommodations at any phase of the application or interview process, please let us know. We would be happy to support you and discuss accommodations as required.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/silverorange-director-of-business-development-1

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative’s user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
You’ll drive growth and adoption across the self-serve product experience, focusing on how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There’s no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.
PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you’ll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

What you’ll do
• 
Drive growth and adoption of the self-serve product, focusing on onboarding, activation, and upgrade moments, and partnering with growth, lifecycle, and pricing teams where they connect
• 
Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows
• 
Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects
• 
Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform
• 
Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up
• 
Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product
• 
Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans
• 
Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

Requirements
• 
5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products
• 
A track record of moving growth and adoption metrics through the products you’ve shipped
• 
Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision
• 
Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end
• 
Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself
• 
Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved
• 
Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact
• 
A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows
• 
Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec
• 
Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

As an AI Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing AI models and applications that enhance our products and services. Key Responsibilities: - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and translate them into technical specifications. - Develop and maintain AI models, ensuring they are efficient and scalable. - Work on full stack development tasks, including front-end and back-end programming, to integrate AI solutions into existing systems. - Conduct research to stay updated on the latest AI technologies and methodologies. - Test and validate AI models to ensure accuracy and reliability. - Document processes and maintain clear communication with team members and stakeholders. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of AI concepts and technologies. - Proficiency in full stack development, including experience with relevant programming languages and frameworks. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. - Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. - Strong communication skills to effectively convey technical information. This is an exciting opportunity for individuals looking to grow their careers in AI and full stack development. If you are eager to learn and contribute to innovative projects, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities
• Analyze large volumes of analytical data (sales, customer, product) to identify patterns, trends, and insights.
• Develop and maintain data reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, etc.)
• Collaborate with business teams to understand key business objectives and data needs.
• Analyze customer behavior, product usage, and historical purchase data to identify cross-selling opportunities.
• Ensure data models and structures are well-designed to facilitate analysis and reporting.
• Act as a bridge between data engineers and business stakeholders , ensuring data is aligned with business needs.
Skill set
• 4-8 years of experience in a data analyst role
• Excellent communication and presentation skills are essential.
• Proficient in data engineering tools and languages such as Python, SQL, and Java.
• Strong knowledge of business intelligence (BI) tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar for creating reports and dashboards.
• Ability to work with databases(SQL & NoSQL) and perform complex data queries.
• Familiarity with data wrangling, ETL processes and data cleaning techniques.
• Clear understanding of data warehousing & cloud based analytics .
• Ability to apply data insights to influence marketing strategies, sales tactics, and product offerings.
• Experience in Azure Data Factory and Azure Data Lake

Headquarters: Kaupmehe 7 Tallinn, 10114 Estonia
 
URL: http://ilogos.biz

iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies.

About the project:
This is the next generation of multiplayer gaming, transforming classic poker into an immersive digital spectacle. An interactive competitive platform where players, spectators, and hosts become full-fledged participants in one large-scale shared experience.
At the heart of the project is the concept of the Digital Coliseum — a digital arena where every game becomes a public performance, and audience attention becomes the platform’s most valuable asset and the foundation of its in-game economy.About the Role
We’re looking for a 2D Artist to help shape the visual world of a mobile poker game set in a high-life solarpunk future — a stylish, technologically advanced, optimistic vision of tomorrow.
You’ll create a wide range of UI elements, game props, customization assets, and thematic visual sets while working within an established art direction. The key challenge is maintaining a strong and consistent visual language across a large amount of diverse content.
The ideal candidate understands how to build assets as part of a cohesive visual system, rather than treating each asset as a standalone illustration. The style should feel premium, futuristic, refined, and sophisticated, with a strong solarpunk influence — without visual clutter.

Requirements:
• 
Strong understanding of form, color, materials, composition, and stylization.
• 
Ability to work confidently within an established art direction and visual language.
• 
Experience creating game UI, props, icons, customization assets, or casual/mobile game art.
• 
Strong sense of visual consistency and attention to detail.
• 
Ability to create diverse assets that still feel like part of the same game world and visual system.
• 
Understanding of how to keep interfaces clean, readable, and visually balanced, even with a large amount of customization content.
• 
Ability to work independently from briefs and effectively incorporate feedback from an Art Director.
• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating relevant 2D game art and/or UI work.Key Duties:
• 
Create 2D UI and in-game visual elements for a mobile poker game.
• 
Design props and customization assets for player profiles, avatars, poker tables, and the game environment.
• 
Create playing cards, card backs, chips, table elements, accessories, rewards, status elements, and other game assets.
• 
Develop themed visual sets that can transform the overall look of cards, tables, UI, and the game screen around a single theme.
• 
Explore shapes, materials, colors, and details within the established high-life solarpunk / futuristic visual language.
• 
Maintain a consistent level of quality and visual cohesion across a large volume of assets.
• 
Work from art briefs and collaborate closely with the Art Director and UI/UX team.
• 
Take assets through to a polished, production-ready state.

Working conditions:

Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well:

• 
Work remotely from anywhere in the world;
• 
Flexible working hours.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ilogos-2d-artist-props-and-customization
